penguins/input.csv.config_yaml:
run:
  name: initial_sweep
  data: penguins/input.csv
# preprocessing plan pp_f2b811c215 revision 1 (707712d0b5e3)
preprocessing:
  drop_columns: []
  missing_indicator_groups:
    bill_length_mm_and_3_more:
    - bill_length_mm
    - bill_depth_mm
    - flipper_length_mm
    - body_mass_g
  impute:
    bill_length_mm:
      method: fill_median
      indicator: false
    bill_depth_mm:
      method: fill_median
      indicator: false
    flipper_length_mm:
      method: fill_median
      indicator: false
    body_mass_g:
      method: fill_median
      indicator: false
    sex:
      method: fill_value
      value: (blank)
      indicator: false
  encode:
    species:
      method: one_hot
    island:
      method: one_hot
    sex:
      method: one_hot
sweep:
  projection:
    method: jl
    dimensions:
      values: [3, 5, 10]
    seed:
      values: [42, 7, 13]
    center: true
  # Legacy mirror for older configs. sweep.projection is authoritative.
  pca:
    dimensions:
      values: [3, 5, 10]
    seed:
      values: [42, 7, 13]
  ball_mapper:
    epsilon:
      range:
        min: 0.5173
        max: 1.6659
        steps: 24
cosmic_graph:
  construction_threshold: auto
output:
  n_reps: 4
